paite: Oded tapa Azariah tung ah Pathian kha ahong tung hi.
heading: Asa Kipuahthakna Thilhihte

paite: Asa dawn ding in apaikhia a, akiang ah, "Asa leh Judah mi tengteng leh Benjamin mite aw, ka thu ngaikhe dih ua, alam a na pan sung teng un nou lam ah TOUPA apang, amah na zon uleh na mu ding ua, amah na lehngatsan uleh ama'n ahon lehngatsan ding.
Israel mite sawtpi Pathian tak nei lou leh sinsakmi leh siampu nei lou leh dan nei lou in a-om uhi.
Himahleh, amangbat ua TOUPA Israel' Pathian lam angat ua, azontak un amu uhi.
Huai lai in apawt lam leh alut lamte a ding in galmuanna a-om kei a, gamsung a om tengteng a ding in mangbatna thupi mahmah ngen ahi zaw.
Nam leh nam, khua leh khua akihihsia ua, Pathian in haksatna chiteng in ahaksasak hi.
Himahleh, nou zaw hattak in om unla, kithadahsak kei un, na thilhih man uh na mu ding uhi," achi hi.

Huchi in Asa in huai thute leh zawlnei Oded thugente azak in akihangsak a, Judah gam leh Benjamin gam tengteng a kipan leh Ephraim tanggam a kholak a kipan athilkihhuaite apaimang vek a; TOUPA' inn lim chin a TOUPA maitam abawlhoih hi.
udah gam leh Benjamin gammi tengteng, akiang a om Ephraim leh Manasseh leh Simeon gam a mite toh asamkhawm vek a, TOUPA Pathian akiang ah a-om chih atheih un Israel gam a pan in ahong bel vek uhi.
Huchi in Asa vaihawm akum sawm leh kum nga, akha thumna ah Jerusalem ah akikaikhawm uhi.
Huai ni in agallak uh bawngtal zasagih leh belam sangsagih in TOUPA kiang ah akithoih uhi.
Alungsim uh leh alungtang tengteng un TOUPA apipute uh Pathian zong ding leh;
kuapeuh TOUPA Israel' Pathian zong lou aneu leh alian, anumei apasal in hihlup ding thu akhung uhi.
Huchi in TOUPA kiang ah aw ngaihtak a ging in, akikou ua, pengkul ging toh, pengkul binei ging toh akichiam uhi.
Judah mi tengteng akichiamna uah akipak ua, alungtangtak ua kichiam a, kituaktak a ahih ziak un, muh leng amu him ua; huchi in TOUPA'N mun chih ah galmuang a omna apia hi.
Kumpipa Asa nu Maakah leng milim kihhuaitak Asherah abawlsak ziak in akumpinu hihna atawpsak a; huchi in Asa in milim aphuk a, ahihzan vek a, Kidron lui ah ahal hi.
Himahleh, Israel gam a kipan mun sangte paihmang ahi kei a; himahleh Asa lungsim avaihawm sung in akizen gige hi.
Apa thillatte leh ama latte dangkasik, dangka-eng, tui-um belsuan Pathian inn ah alalut hi.
Asa vaihawm lai kum sawmthum-le-nga sung in kidou himhim a-om nawn kei hi.
